entities.summary: Ralf Johannes Josephus Mackenbach is a Dutch plasma physicist, artist and former child singer, best known for winning the Junior Eurovision Song Contest 2009 with the song "Click Clack". He is the first and, to date, only Dutch winner of the contest.
